app.name: Luma

onboarding.subtitle: Select the language for Luma’s interface. You can change this later in Settings.

status.enterApiKey: Enter an API key before adding.
status.apiKeyActiveFailed: Failed to set active API key.

hotkey.listeningHint: Listening… press key combo (Esc to cancel)

region.hint: Drag to select a region · Esc to cancel
region.title: Select Region

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.idleHint: Type a word or sentence, then press Enter to look it up.

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.idleHint: Ask a question like on Gemini chat. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.

updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: Luma checks for updates when it starts. You can install the new version inside the app — it replaces this copy and restarts. Settings stay in Luma-Data.
updates.portableHint: The app downloads the new portable file, replaces this one, and restarts. You do not need to visit GitHub.

statusBar.grammarEmpty: Grammar correction was empty, so nothing could be replaced.
statusBar.grammarFailed: Could not correct the selected text.
